purpose: External semantic corroboration for selected V2 team-match promotion candidates. Presence here is review evidence only and does not expose a field.

statsperform_opta_event_definitions.use: Direct Opta definitions for touches, unsuccessful touches and ball recoveries.

statsperform_fifa_match_data_definitions.use: Direct definition support for blocked-pass / blocked-cross defensive actions.

statsperform_betting_showcase_pass_defin.use: Direct definition of chipped passes and explicit statement that Opta pass events can be categorised by defensive/middle/final-third pitch zones.

premierleague_stats_clarification.use: Official Premier League statistical vocabulary and Opta data-capture provenance, including recoveries and goal kicks.

blockedPass.note: Stats Perform explicitly distinguishes a blocked pass/cross as a defensive action when a cleanly played pass is intercepted on its intended path. Team-match aggregation still requires ordinary FRL coverage/missingness review.

totalChippedPass.note: Stats Perform explicitly defines a chipped pass as a lofted pass with an intended recipient. The source key strongly indicates the team-match count of this event type.

totalFinalThirdPasses.note: Opta documentation explicitly states that passes can be broken down by defensive, middle and final-third pitch zones. Exact aggregate inclusion semantics are supported by the complete decade-wide profile and the successful<=total invariant.

successfulFinalThirdPasses.proposed_label: Successful passes in the final third
successfulFinalThirdPasses.note: Final-third pass categorisation is directly supported by Opta documentation. The successful subset interpretation is supported by a 7,600-row zero-violation successful<=total invariant.

ballRecovery.note: Stats Perform directly defines a Ball Recovery as the first controlled action after open-play possession changes between teams. The team-match field has complete numeric decade-wide coverage.

goalKicks.note: The Premier League explicitly lists goal kicks in its Opta-derived goalkeeping statistics. The source field remains held because its occasional blanks combined with no observed zeros require explicit sparse-zero semantics.

touches.note: Stats Perform defines Touches as the sum of events where a player touches the ball, excluding events such as Aerial Lost or Challenge Lost. The team-match aggregate has complete numeric decade-wide coverage.

touchesInOppBox.note: The underlying touch-event definition is direct. The opposition-box qualifier is supported by a 7,598-row zero-violation touchesInOppBox<=touches invariant, but the field remains held because two blanks and no observed zeros require explicit sparse-zero semantics.

unsuccessfulTouch.note: Stats Perform directly defines an unsuccessful touch as a poor mis-control, with certain mishit shots also included. The team-match field has complete numeric decade-wide coverage and a 7,600-row zero-violation unsuccessfulTouch<=touches invariant.

governance_note: External terminology corroborates concepts but never substitutes for FRL source-field, missingness, aggregation and comparability review.
